comingLast.roast: tied with Downes - the blue balls love a countback drama
on 19 at 1.1 a hole - the presentation table is being set
one hot hole and the blue balls change address to Talbot's locker
Talbot needs him to stay exactly this bad for 4 more holes
1 point buys freedom - Talbot is pricing it higher by the minute
on 19, needs 4 - somebody radio ahead to the bar
escape requires 4 over the last 5 - his mates have started filming
tied for last with Talbot - one of them buys, both of them stay
2 points clear from the bar - watching Talbot like a hawk with a beer
safe-ish by 3 - the blue balls have come back from further
